A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GenLIP research. Their complete main texts, tables, figures, equations, and appendices are readable and can be matched reliably across revisions.

before.justification: v2 reports original GenLIP benchmark results, scaling experiments, controlled ablations, classification and segmentation evaluations, and qualitative analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds Flickr30K retrieval results and stage-specific ImageNet results.

M1.justification: Table 1 revises the reported GenLIP-L feed-forward width from 2816 to 2752. The unified Transformer, Prefix-LM objective, MRoPE, gated attention, and visual-feature extraction procedure remain unchanged. This establishes a limited reported configuration revision, without establishing retraining.

E1.justification: New Appendix A adds Flickr30K zero-shot text-to-image and image-to-text retrieval. The previous multimodal, classification, segmentation, and qualitative evaluation coverage is retained.

E2.justification: The new retrieval comparison in Table 12 introduces IG Captioner L/14 as a comparator alongside CLIP, SigLIP, and SigLIP2. Comparator membership in the existing experiments is unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported Stage 2 sample budget changes from 37M to 39M, and Table 11 changes the SigLIP2 configuration from So/14 to So/16. The new retrieval evaluation uses generative scoring following Visual-GPTScore and bidirectional Recall@1. The PDFs do not establish whether existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Table 11 adds a comparison of ImageNet accuracy before and after Stage 2 across three model sizes, testing the classification cost of native-aspect-ratio adaptation. Existing gating, register-token, SAIL, scaling, resolution, and qualitative failure analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without reported random seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-estimation practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 11 adds Stage 2 ImageNet accuracies of 82.8, 83.1, and 83.0, and replaces L/16's 83.9 with 83.8 explicitly labeled S1. New Table 12 reports retrieval results, including GenLIP-g/16 Recall@1 of 72.5 text-to-image and 63.7 image-to-text. Section 4.2.1 corrects the L/16 advantage from 2.5 to 2.8 points; the corresponding Table 3 scores remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The sequence definition, language-modeling loss, and gated-attention equations are unchanged. No formal assumptions, theoretical results, proofs, or substantive derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The introduction softens the categorical claim that contrastive pretraining introduces an objective mismatch to saying it may not be fully aligned with generative training. The abstract and conclusion retain the same simplicity, scalability, and multimodal-performance contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4.5 qualifies discriminative scaling by training stage and explicitly acknowledges that Stage 2 lowers ImageNet accuracy at every model size. New Appendix A identifies retrieval as a weakness relative to contrastive approaches. Existing limitations and attention-mechanism interpretations are retained.

D1.justification: Section 3.3 and Table 1 replace anonymous Dataset-S1/S2 descriptions with essential training-data provenance: Recap-DataComp-1B for Stage 1, and 27M BLIP3o-Long-Caption, 10M Infinity-MM stage1, and 2M CapRL samples for Stage 2. Identifying both stages and the mixture substantially expands reproducibility information. The code/model access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Seven references are added, principally documenting training datasets and the retrieval benchmark/scoring approach. The existing references and substantive positioning against contrastive, encoder-decoder, and SAIL-style approaches are retained.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose and terminology corrections, expands dataset descriptions, rewrites the discriminative-results discussion, adds a retrieval appendix, and updates an affiliation. The main section structure and most explanatory text remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds retrieval Table 12, expands Table 1's dataset breakdown, and reformats Table 11 to distinguish training stages. Caption corrections include Table 5's task categories and Figure 6's prompt. Existing figure images are unchanged; other differences are local reflow and table/appendix renumbering.

improvement.justification: v3 identifies previously unspecified training data, corrects reporting inconsistencies, and adds evidence exposing classification-adaptation and retrieval limitations. These changes improve reproducibility and the balance of the conclusions. The overall gain is limited because the central method and main multimodal benchmark evidence remain largely unchanged.
